title: list_data_mappings input
description: The data mappings (O26) across every domain in one list: where each domain's data is kept, its origin, and for a copy outside production its decision state under the copy rule (OP-16, computed when read). Open mappings by default. Filters by domain (with the domains below it), location, origin, copy state and words; dataMappingIds reads given mappings, ended ones too. Writes nothing.

domainKey.description: Only mappings of this domain and, unless includeSubtree is false, of the domains below it.

includeSubtree.description: False keeps the mappings of domainKey itself only.

dataMappingIds.description: Only these mappings, whatever their end date (a mapping's record page). Each must exist.

copyStates.description: Only copies outside production in these decision states.

text.description: Words that must appear in the domain's path or the location's name.

includeEnded.description: True adds the ended, retired and archived mappings.
